request: How much money do I have in my savings?
Move $500 from my savings to my checking.
expectedAnswer: Transferred $500 from savings to checking. Your savings balance is now $3,000 and your checking balance is $1,750.

request: Move all my savings into checking, then close savings.
expectedAnswer: Transferred your full savings balance of $3,500 to checking and closed your savings account. Your checking balance is now $4,750 and your closed savings account has a zero balance.
Your savings account still has $3,500. Where would you like that money moved before I close the account? I have left your account open and made no changes.
I cannot transfer $4,000 because your savings account only has $3,500. No transfer was made; your savings balance remains $3,500 and your checking balance remains $1,250.
